findings.message: Relative imports use `.ts` extensions ('../shared/env.ts' line 5, './schema.ts' line 6). Under NodeNext + verbatimModuleSyntax tsc -b emits TS5097 and the apps/api typecheck/build break — already confirmed blocking in the smoke wave (findings-wave-smoke F-001). Sprint-001 convention is `.js` extensions on relative imports.

Barrel re-export uses `.ts` extension (`export * from '../modules/auth/schema.ts'`). Same TS5097 class as client.ts — rewrite to `'../modules/auth/schema.js'` so the schema barrel can be consumed by client.ts and downstream wave-5+ modules without breaking emit.

Module-level `new Pool(...)` plus `export const db = createDb(pool)` opens a real pg connection pool at import time and depends on the eager `env` singleton from shared/env.ts. This defeats the buildApp(env) DI seam wave-7 needs for JWT_SECRET fail-fast tests and forces every test that imports anything transitive through db/client.ts to spin up Postgres. Expose only `createDb(pool)` and a `createPool(env: Env)` factory; main.ts builds them once after loadEnv().

`hashRefreshToken(raw): string` is synchronous, but the task-auth-tokens contract in sprint-001.tasks.json line 503 mandates `hashRefreshToken(raw): Promise<string>`. Callers typed against the spec will see a signature mismatch. Change to `async function hashRefreshToken(raw: string): Promise<string>` (returns the same hex string; async wraps it) or escalate to the planner for a spec amendment.

Connection-pool sizing (max 10, idleTimeoutMillis: 30_000, connectionTimeoutMillis: 5_000) is hardcoded; enriched task spec said `sized from env` but env.ts has no DB_POOL_MAX / DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS / DB_CONN_TIMEOUT_MS keys — a planner gap. Either extend env.ts (requires target_files amendment since env.ts is not in this task's scope) or amend the spec to accept the constants; surface via step.ask before wave-5.

Top-level `const _env = loadEnv(); void _env;` is redundant: shared/env.ts already eager-loads via `export const env: Env = loadEnv()` at line 26, so the first import of env.ts already throws on an undersized JWT_SECRET. The explicit call is harmless today but becomes load-bearing only after the env eager-singleton is removed (the wave-3 logger DI fix posture).

Schema barrel currently re-exports only ../modules/auth/schema; matches ARCHITECTURE.md §4.2 barrel convention. No action this wave — downstream tasks (wave-5+) will add additional module schema re-exports here.
